response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep exposure to TypeScript, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and agentic workflows via MCP, with notable open-source contributions and leadership in technical communities; however, his resume lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade AI systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph, and his AI experience appears adjacent rather than core.
strengths: Proven experience with MCP and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Extensive full-stack engineering background with TypeScript, AWS, and cloud-native systems
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source contributions
concerns: No clear demonstration of 8+ years dedicated to production AI systems or LLM deployment
Missing explicit experience with vector databases, RAG, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph
Limited evidence of customer-facing technical leadership in GenAI consulting contexts
